shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la out docs 2>&1; echo "---"; cat out/bundle-manifest.txt 2>&1

find docs -name '*.md' -type f | sort | while read f; do printf '%s %s %s %s\n' "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$f"; done; echo "---"; grep -v '^#' out/bundle-manifest.txt | awk '{print $1, $2, $3, $4}' | sort -k4 | diff - <(find d

for f in $(find docs -name '*.md' -type f | sort); do echo "$(shasum -a 256 $f | cut -d' ' -f1) $(wc -c < $f | tr -d ' ') $(wc -l < $f | tr -d ' ') $f"; done > /tmp/verify-manifest.txt; grep -v '^#' out/bundle-manifest.txt | grep -v '^$' | awk '{print $1, $2, $3, $4}' > /tmp/listed.txt; diff /tmp/li

shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md
